sounds.prompt: Ebook reader: opening a hardcover book — cover lifts, spine gives a little, first pages settle. Natural paper foley, no musical tones, under 1s.
Ebook reader: flipping one page forward — quick paper flick and swish, crisp but soft, about 350ms. This will repeat a lot, so keep it unfatiguing.
Same reader: flipping one page backward. Same paper as the forward flip but the motion reversed — swish sweeps the other way, slightly softer.
Ebook reader: closing the book — pages compress, then a soft muted cover thud. Satisfying, not loud.
Ebook reader: adding a bookmark — a satin ribbon laid across the page plus a tiny soft paper tap. Very short and quiet.
Ebook reader: dragging a highlighter / pen stroke across paper — a felt-tip drawing sound with fine grainy texture, about 600ms, slight pitch of motion.
Ebook reader: finishing a chapter — a gentle warm cue, maybe a soft page settle with one quiet wooden or glassy tone. Calm, under 900ms.
